build_text_to_image: build a StableDiffusionPipeline to generate images from text prompts using a pretrained model
create_prompt_embeddings: create prompt embeddings by encoding text prompts with the CLIP text encoder for image generation
run_safety_checker: run the safety checker on generated images to detect not-safe-for-work content
test_classifier_free_guidance: test classifier free guidance by generating images with and without negative prompts
refactor_ip_adapter: refactor the IP Adapter image embedding preparation to support multiple image inputs
